description: Add Vitest unit tests for the readiness engine (required boundary tests from testing.md steering file) and for the Groq/Supabase integration layer (mocked). Ensure deterministic scoring logic is thoroughly tested.
steps: Create vitest.config.ts at project root with TypeScript path aliases matching tsconfig.json.

Create tests/engine/readiness-engine.test.ts: Implement all required test cases from testing.md steering file: perfect score -> READY, zero score -> FURTHER_PREPARATION, exact threshold (80%) -> READY, one point below (79%) -> REVIEW_REQUIRED, high score with critical failure -> REVIEW_REQUIRED, multiple critical failures -> REVIEW_REQUIRED, mandatory competency below threshold -> not READY, incomplete attempt -> error thrown, unknown/duplicate question IDs -> rejected, deterministic repeat execution.

Create tests/lib/groq-client.test.ts: Unit test the Groq client wrapper (functions/lib/groq.ts) with mocked fetch. Test: successful response parsing, timeout handling, rate limit retry, malformed response handling.

Create tests/lib/validation.test.ts: Test Zod validation schemas used in API functions. Test: empty message rejected, oversized message (>2000 chars) rejected, missing required fields, invalid question IDs.
Ensure all tests pass with pnpm run test -- --run
acceptance_criteria: vitest.config.ts is configured with path aliases
Readiness engine has 10+ test cases covering all boundary conditions from testing.md
Groq client tests verify error handling and retry logic
Validation tests confirm Zod schemas reject invalid input
pnpm run test -- --run passes all tests
